company.name: Toggle Market
company.shortDescription: B2B SaaS-enabled marketplaces and digital procurement platforms for cross border trade and commerce
company.description:
Toggle Market is a technology company building B2B industry-specific SaaS-enabled marketplaces through virtual end-to-end procurement platforms that digitise the high-friction wholesale commerce of non-standard goods. Initial focus on hospitality and healthcare. 

ToggleHospitality and ToggleHealthcare marketplaces enable the full cycle of B2B procurement process for operating supplies, fixtures, furniture and specialist equipment. These eco-systems are engineered to boost efficiency, reduce time, cost, environmental waste and the stress that comes with the complex nature of such multi-vendor cross border transactions - combining a B2C search and source experience with SaaS workflow tools for order management and project collaboration, as well as direct chat connectivity between buyers and suppliers..
